name: PiSensor system test plan
deployment: PiSensor full system deployment, as flown: no test component

not_covered_ack: Error branches of inherited components that need a bus or driver fault not plantable on this bench: unit tests of the catalog cover them.
coverage.rationale: Baselines of the skill; thresholds apply to the new component piCamera, whose campaign reports unit-test coverage.

final_state.accepted_evidence: bench sha256sum of the L7-1 product file, taken over ssh after the run into record/raw/final-state.txt, compared by the auditor with the sha256 of the ground file in record/raw/files/
final_state.rationale: The on-board CRC command runs inside the UUT process; the bench reads the file itself, outside the UUT's reporting path.

scope: L0: desk-checked; bench confirmation pending. Marker: `cmdDisp.CMD_NO_OP_STRING(arg1)` -> event `cmdDisp.NoOpStringReceived`, the id sent as a decimal string. Link budget [I]: RFM69 at the catalog default data rate 19200 bit/s carries about 2400 byte/s; sensor telemetry at 1 Hz leaves the rest to CFDP, so a 100 kB product takes on the order of a minute.
- UUT: the PiSensor deployment of `docs/ssdd.md` on the Raspberry Pi 5 `soakee`, 64-bit Raspberry Pi OS.

- Test deployment: the deployment itself. No component is added for testing. Markers use `cmdDisp`, the on-board file check uses `fileManager.CalculateCrc`, the directory listing uses `fileManager.ListDirectory`, product names come from `dpWriter.FileWritten`, platform identity is a bench action over ssh.

- Ground system: fprime-yamcs at the ledger pin with the project YAMCS configuration directory (CFDP service), joined to the radio by `alpha-iii-yamcs` 0.1.0 (wheel pinned by sha-256 in the SSDD) and the RFM69 Feather ground station on USB serial.

- Record content (`record/`): every exported row carries the ground reception time beside the FSW time; `record/raw/bench-actions.log` holds each bench action with its bench start and end time; every CFDP file received is copied to `record/raw/files/` before it is checked; CFDP class and outcome come from the YAMCS transfer record exported to `record/raw/cfdp.json`.
- Completeness: every window requires STD; an overflowed queue makes the window UNVERIFIED, never a pass of an absence check.
- Bench and Pi clocks: both synchronised by NTP; the offset is measured at L0-1 and must be under 0.5 s; tolerances that compare the two clocks use 2 s.
- Heartbeat: `imuManager.Reading`, written to the telemetry packet every 1 Hz cycle; `cmdDisp.CommandsDispatched` updates on change only.
- Minimum sample counts come from the requirement: one sample per 2 s of window outside a downlink (30 in 60 s, 15 in 30 s).
- `dpCat.START_XMIT_CATALOG` is always sent with `remainActive` false: a product stored after the catalog is built is not sent in that downlink.
- Telemetry gaps are judged on ground reception time: the requirement is stated at the ground. Telemetry is sent at 1 Hz, so the 2 s bound leaves one period of margin for radio delay.
- A CAPTURE that fails makes its window UNVERIFIED through STD (`OpCodeError`), not FAIL: the run is then repeated after the cause is found.
- CFDP as shipped deletes a file after sending it (`cfdpManager.FileInDefaultKeep`, default DELETE): the on-board CRC is taken before the downlink, and L7-1 sets KEEP.

- Constants: temperature -20 to 60 degC and gravity 8 to 12 m/s^2 are plausibility bounds for an indoor bench at rest; 1 km is the GPS plausibility bound around the surveyed bench position; 0.1 deg is the rounding allowance of the roll and pitch computation; the 30 s downlink precondition is three times the 10 s bound; the file CRC is that of `Os::File::calculateCrc`; the product directory is `DataProductsConfig.Paths.dpDir`.
- Out of scope: BMP280 pressure; yaw.
entry_gates: - Component campaign `picam` closed; its unit tests pass.
- Image built from the manifest SHAs; L0-1 and L0-2 pass on the bench.
- Product directory empty at the start of each test (bench teardown removes the products of the test over ssh; L7-1 has no teardown).
- Bench recipe: BMP280, MPU6050, GPS receiver with a fix and Pi Camera attached to the Pi 5; Feather M0 RFM69HCW ground station on the ground host USB.
levels: L0 provenance and feasibility · L2 functional · L7 final state. No L3, L4, L5 or L6 test: no system requirement states restart, endurance, fault or rejection behaviour; those belong to the components.
not_covered: - Fault, warning and rejection behaviour of `piCamera`: its component campaign.
- Fault and warning behaviour of inherited components: not required at system level; their own tests, where they exist, cover it.
- CFDP uplink, packet loss and retransmission: no system requirement.
- Radio interference and range: the RFM69 link is tested at bench range only.
- Today's bench cannot run these tests: the BMP280 and GPS receiver do not answer, and the camera and the Feather ground station are absent.
decision_log: 1. 2026-11-18 designer — test deployment = the deployment as flown; no test component (human direction).
2. 2026-11-18 designer — product content is judged on the ground copy of the file; `fileManager.CalculateCrc` gives the on-board check and the bench `sha256sum` the independent final state.
3. 2026-11-18 designer — planted faults insert commands of existing components only; a grown or altered product file is not usable as a fault because `Svc.DpCatalog` refuses it (size check).
4. 2026-11-18 designer — every test makes its own product; no test depends on a product of another test.

tests.title: Image and platform identity
tests.purpose: Proves the running image is the manifest's image and runs on a Raspberry Pi 5 under 64-bit Raspberry Pi OS, reached over the RFM69.
tests.setup: Deployment running on the Raspberry Pi 5; RFM69 link up.
procedure: action: read /proc/device-tree/model, /etc/os-release and `getconf LONG_BIT` on the Pi over ssh into bench-actions.log
action: list TCP sockets of the deployment process

metrics.text: |Pi clock - bench clock| <= 0.5 s, measured by a bench action (`date` over ssh, logged in bench-actions.log) (require)

tests.evidence: Version events equal the manifest describe strings; check: model starts with "Raspberry Pi 5", os-release ID is the Raspberry Pi OS (Debian) release of the manifest, LONG_BIT == 64; socket list empty; check: the dictionary of the image holds no command of a test component.

tests.title: Marker round-trip
tests.purpose: Proves the marker command round-trips over the RFM69 on the Raspberry Pi 5 so every later window can be bracketed.
procedure: action: read /proc/device-tree/model, /etc/os-release and `getconf LONG_BIT` on the Pi over ssh into bench-actions.log
tests.evidence: Three NoOpStringReceived events in order, strings byte-exact; platform check as L0-1.

tests.title: Sensor telemetry period
tests.purpose: Proves every sensor channel arrives at the ground at least every 2 s.
tests.setup: Deployment running on the Raspberry Pi 5, RFM69 link up through the Feather ground station to fprime-yamcs, all four sensors answering, product directory empty.

metrics.text: for every sensor channel in the window: samples >= 30, and the largest gap between ground reception times, counting window start to first sample and last sample to window end, <= 2 s

tests.evidence: Channel strips over 60 s; check: bmpManager.Reading temperature between -20 and 60 degC; imuManager.Reading acceleration magnitude between 8 and 12 m/s^2 and angular rate magnitude <= 0.5 rad/s (bench at rest; MPU6050 datasheet zero-rate offset 20 deg/s); gpsManager.Reading within 1 km of the bench position in the manifest.

tests.title: Sensor telemetry period under command traffic
tests.purpose: Proves the 2 s telemetry period holds while commands are dispatched.
tests.setup: Deployment running on the Raspberry Pi 5, RFM69 link up through the Feather ground station to fprime-yamcs, all four sensors answering, product directory empty.

metrics.text: for every sensor channel in the window: samples >= 15, and the largest gap between ground reception times, counting window start to first sample and last sample to window end, <= 2 s

tests.evidence: As L2-1; check: event cmdDisp.NoOpReceived count == 3.

tests.title: Capture and downlink of one product
tests.purpose: Proves one capture stores one product with a JPEG of at least 640x480, the metrics and their times, sampled within 2 s of the capture, delivered byte-identical by CFDP class 2.
tests.setup: Deployment running on the Raspberry Pi 5, RFM69 link up through the Feather ground station to fprime-yamcs, all four sensors answering, product directory empty.
procedure: wait event dpCat.CatalogXmitCompleted and every CFDP transaction of the window finished at the ground

metrics.text: t(event dpWriter.FileWritten) - t(cmdDisp.OpCodeDispatched of piCamera.CAPTURE) <= 30 s, for each CAPTURE (FSW clock)
bench time of CAPTURE sent - 2 s <= capture time record <= time of CAPTURE completion + 2 s
the latitude, longitude, roll, pitch and temperature records each carry a sample time, and |sample time - capture time record| <= 2 s for each

tests.evidence:
check: event dpWriter.FileWritten count == 1; check: exactly one file arrived; check: CRC of record/raw/files/

, computed by the bench with the F Prime file CRC, == value in the fileManager.CalculateCrcSucceeded event of P; check: every CFDP transaction in the window is class 2 and finished complete at the ground; checks on the ground file: it parses as an F Prime data product container; the picture record starts FFD8 and ends FFD9, SOF0 width >= 640 and height >= 480; one latitude, one longitude, one roll, one pitch and one temperature record.

tests.title: Two captures, one catalog downlink
tests.purpose: Proves a second capture stores a second product with its own capture time and the catalog downlinks both, byte-identical.
tests.setup: Deployment running on the Raspberry Pi 5, RFM69 link up through the Feather ground station to fprime-yamcs, all four sensors answering, product directory empty.
procedure: wait event dpCat.CatalogXmitCompleted and every CFDP transaction of the window finished at the ground

metrics.text: t(event dpWriter.FileWritten) - t(cmdDisp.OpCodeDispatched of piCamera.CAPTURE) <= 30 s, for each CAPTURE (FSW clock)
bench time of CAPTURE sent - 2 s <= capture time record <= time of CAPTURE completion + 2 s
the latitude, longitude, roll, pitch and temperature records each carry a sample time, and |sample time - capture time record| <= 2 s for each

tests.evidence: check: event dpWriter.FileWritten count == 2 with different names; capture time of P2 later than that of P1; check: exactly two files arrived; check: CRC of record/raw/files/<P1> and <P2>, computed by the bench with the F Prime file CRC, == value in the fileManager.CalculateCrcSucceeded event of P; check: every CFDP transaction in the window is class 2 and finished complete at the ground; checks on the ground file: it parses as an F Prime data product container; the picture record starts FFD8 and ends FFD9, SOF0 width >= 640 and height >= 480; one latitude, one longitude, one roll, one pitch and one temperature record.

tests.purpose: Proves the metrics stored in a product are the sensor readings downlinked around its capture.
tests.setup: Deployment running on the Raspberry Pi 5, RFM69 link up through the Feather ground station to fprime-yamcs, all four sensors answering, product directory empty.
procedure: wait event dpCat.CatalogXmitCompleted and every CFDP transaction of the window finished at the ground

metrics.text: bench time of CAPTURE sent - 2 s <= capture time record <= time of CAPTURE completion + 2 s
the latitude, longitude, roll, pitch and temperature records each carry a sample time, and |sample time - capture time record| <= 2 s for each

tests.evidence: check: every CFDP transaction in the window is class 2 and finished complete at the ground; check: exactly one file arrived; checks on the ground file: it parses as an F Prime data product container; the picture record starts FFD8 and ends FFD9, SOF0 width >= 640 and height >= 480; one latitude, one longitude, one roll, one pitch and one temperature record; check: the temperature record equals a bmpManager.Reading sample of the window; the latitude and longitude records equal a gpsManager.Reading sample of the window; roll and pitch equal, within 0.1 deg, the bench computation from the acceleration of an imuManager.Reading sample of the window.

tests.title: Capture time bound, repeated
tests.purpose: Proves three captures in a row each store their product within 30 s.
tests.setup: Deployment running on the Raspberry Pi 5, RFM69 link up through the Feather ground station to fprime-yamcs, all four sensors answering, product directory empty.

metrics.text: t(event dpWriter.FileWritten) - t(cmdDisp.OpCodeDispatched of piCamera.CAPTURE) <= 30 s, for each CAPTURE (FSW clock)

tests.title: Telemetry during a downlink
tests.purpose: Proves sensor telemetry continues at least every 10 s while products are downlinked over the RFM69.
tests.setup: Deployment running on the Raspberry Pi 5, RFM69 link up through the Feather ground station to fprime-yamcs, all four sensors answering, product directory empty.
procedure: wait event dpCat.CatalogXmitCompleted and every CFDP transaction of the window finished at the ground

metrics.text: for every sensor channel in D: samples >= 3, and the largest gap between ground reception times, counting window start to first sample and last sample to window end, <= 10 s
CFDP transaction duration in D >= 30 s

rationale.pred: CFDP transaction duration in D >= 30 s
rationale.text: a precondition (require): a downlink shorter than 30 s cannot show the 10 s bound

tests.evidence:
check: event dpWriter.FileWritten count == 1 over the whole test (Q and D); check: exactly one file arrived; check: rfm69Manager.PacketsTransmitted and rfm69Manager.PacketsReceived each rise in D; check: CRC of record/raw/files/

, computed by the bench with the F Prime file CRC, == value in the fileManager.CalculateCrcSucceeded event of P; check: every CFDP transaction in the window is class 2 and finished complete at the ground.

tests.title: Telemetry and commands during a downlink
tests.purpose: Proves sensor telemetry continues and a command is served while two products are downlinked.
tests.setup: Deployment running on the Raspberry Pi 5, RFM69 link up through the Feather ground station to fprime-yamcs, all four sensors answering, product directory empty.
procedure: wait event dpCat.CatalogXmitCompleted and both CFDP transactions finished at the ground

metrics.text: for every sensor channel in D: samples >= 3, and the largest gap between ground reception times, counting window start to first sample and last sample to window end, <= 10 s
CFDP transaction duration in D >= 30 s

rationale.pred: CFDP transaction duration in D >= 30 s

tests.evidence: check: event cmdDisp.NoOpReceived count == 1 during the downlink; check: exactly two files arrived; check: every CFDP transaction in the window is class 2 and finished complete at the ground.

tests.purpose: Leaves one known product on board for the independent final-state check.
tests.setup: Deployment running on the Raspberry Pi 5, RFM69 link up through the Feather ground station to fprime-yamcs, all four sensors answering, product directory empty.
procedure: wait event dpCat.CatalogXmitCompleted and every CFDP transaction of the window finished at the ground
tests.evidence:
check: CRC of record/raw/files/

, computed by the bench with the F Prime file CRC, == value in the fileManager.CalculateCrcSucceeded event of P; checks on the ground file: it parses as an F Prime data product container; the picture record starts FFD8 and ends FFD9, SOF0 width >= 640 and height >= 480; one latitude, one longitude, one roll, one pitch and one temperature record; the directory listing names P only.
